```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(Seurat)
library(scRepertoire)
library(VDJdive)
library(ggpubr)
library(ECLIPSE)

source("/home/ecb86/Desktop/R_tools/VDJdive_ECLIPSE_paperFunctions.R")
set.seed(16)
```

```{r}
############################################################################
###                         Pre-Processing                               ###
############################################################################

braun <- readRDS("/gpfs/boyd/pi/pi_db2475/lab_data/sc_assays/braun_cancer_cell_2021/processed/braun_cancer_cell_seurat.rds")

braun@meta.data <- braun@meta.data %>% separate(Sample, into = c("donor", "tissue"), remove = FALSE, sep = "_")
braun@meta.data <- braun@meta.data %>% mutate(tissue = case_when(
                                                                 tissue %in% c("T", "T2") ~ "Tumor",
                                                                 tissue == "N" ~ "Normal",
                                                                 tissue %in% c("M", "V")  ~ "Other"))

cd8 <- subset(braun, subset = ClusterName_TCells %in% c("Treg", "Activated CD4.1", "Activated CD4.2", "CD4 TCM.1", "CD4 TCM.2", "Mito-high T cells", "-1"), invert = TRUE)

dirs <- list.files("/gpfs/boyd/pi/pi_db2475/lab_data/sc_assays/braun_cancer_cell_2021/raw/TCR/cellranger_output_indexHoppingRemoved", recursive = TRUE, pattern = "all_contig_annotations\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
dirs <- dirs[!str_detect(dirs, "SC_VDJ_ASSEMBLER_CS")]
dirs <- str_replace(dirs, "all.*$", "")

matching <- read.csv("/gpfs/boyd/pi/pi_db2475/ecb86/sc_datasets/braun_cancer_cell/braun_matching2.csv")
matching <- matching %>% filter(Sample != "")

cd8@meta.data <- cd8@meta.data %>% left_join(matching[, 2:3], by = "Sample")
cd8@meta.data <- as.data.frame(cd8@meta.data)
rownames(cd8@meta.data) <- cd8$Cell_barcode
cd8$Cell_Barcode <- str_replace(cd8$Cell_barcode, "\\-.*$", "-1")

ElbowPlot(cd8, ndims = 50)
cd8 <- RunUMAP(cd8, dims = 1:30)

cd8$ClusterName_TCells[cd8$ClusterName_TCells == "PMCH+ terminally Exhausted CD8.1"] <- "PMCH+ terminally \n Exhausted CD8.1"
cd8$ClusterName_TCells[cd8$ClusterName_TCells == "Terminally exhausted CD8.2"] <- "Terminally \n exhausted CD8.2"
cd8$ClusterName_TCells[cd8$ClusterName_TCells == "Terminally exhausted CD8.3"] <- "Terminally \n exhausted CD8.3"

cd8s <- ECLIPSE(contig_folder_paths = dirs, 
                contig_type = "all", 
                seurat_object = cd8, 
                batch = "index", 
                donor = "donor", 
                group = "donor", 
                original_barcode = "Cell_Barcode")

cd8s <- tcrDoubletDetect(cd8s)

```

```{r}
############################################################################
###                             Figure 3B                                ###
############################################################################
df <- cd8s@meta.data %>% mutate(specialClone = case_when(
                                                         cloneCallSource == "VDJdive" & str_detect(CTaa, ":::.*_") ~ "Extra TCRα",
                                                         cloneCallSource == "VDJdive" & str_detect(CTaa, "_.*:::") ~ "Extra TCRβ",
                                                         cloneCallSource == "VDJdive" & !str_detect(CTaa, ":::") ~ "Regular",
                                                         cloneCallSource == "scRepertoire" ~ "Ambiguous",
                                                         is.na(cloneCallSource) ~ "No TCR\nDetected"))


df2 <- df %>% group_by(donor) %>% 
              mutate(donorCount = n()) %>% ungroup() %>%
              group_by(donor, specialClone) %>% 
              summarise(percent = 100 * n() / dplyr::first(donorCount), 
                        donorCount = dplyr::first(donorCount), 
                        count = n()) %>% ungroup()

df2$specialClone <- factor(df2$specialClone, levels = c("No TCR\nDetected", "Ambiguous", "Extra TCRα", "Extra TCRβ", "Regular"))

df2 <- df2 %>% group_by(donor) %>% 
               mutate(regularSize = percent[specialClone == "Regular"]) %>% 
               ungroup()


df2 %>% ggplot(aes(x = reorder(donor, -regularSize), y = percent)) + 
        geom_col(aes(fill = specialClone), color = "white", linewidth = 0.2, width = 0.85) + 
        theme_classic() + 
        labs(x = "Patient", y = "% of cells", fill = "") +
        theme_bw() + 
        theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"), 
              axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"), 
              legend.position = "bottom", 
              legend.margin = margin(t = -5, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
              axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
              axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
              axis.ticks.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.3), 
              axis.text.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 1)),
              axis.ticks.length.y = unit(0.05, "cm"),
              legend.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 4, margin = margin(l = 1, r = -1)),
              axis.title.x = element_text(vjust = -0.5),
              panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.8),
              panel.grid = element_blank(),
              legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm")) +
        scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.015, 0.015), 
                           breaks = seq(0, 100, 10), 
                           labels = c("0", "", "20", "", "40", "", "60", "", "80", "", "100")) +
        scale_fill_manual(limits = c("No TCR\nDetected", "Ambiguous", "Extra TCRα", "Extra TCRβ", "Regular"),
                          labels = c("No TCR\ndetected", "Ambiguous\nchain count", "Extra\nTCRα", "Extra\nTCRβ", "1 TCRα &\n1 TCRβ"),
                          values = c("yellow4", "tan", "firebrick", "plum4", "deepskyblue4")) +
        guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1))

ggsave("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/revisions/figures/3b.pdf", width = 2.5, height = 2.2, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)

### Finding medians/max/min for paper

median(df2_totals$pct3)
```

```{r}
############################################################################
###                             Figure 3C                                ###
############################################################################

### 300x500
df3 <- df2 %>% complete(donor, specialClone)
df3$percent[is.na(df3$percent)] <- 0

paired_df <- df3 %>%
                    filter(specialClone %in% c("Extra TCRα", "Extra TCRβ")) %>%
                    select(donor, specialClone, percent) %>%
                    pivot_wider(
                                names_from = specialClone,
                                values_from = percent)

results <- runPairedTests(paired_df, groups = c("Extra TCRα", "Extra TCRβ"), adjustment_method = "none", runPaired = TRUE)
results$y.position <- 61
                    
wilcox.test(paired_df$`Extra TCRα`, paired_df$`Extra TCRβ`, paired = TRUE)

makeBoxplot(df3 %>% filter(specialClone %in% c("Extra TCRα", "Extra TCRβ")), 
            x = "specialClone", 
            y = "percent", 
            group = "donor", 
            x_title = "", 
            y_title = "% of cells", 
            pval = results, 
            colors = c("firebrick", "plum4"),
            ylim = c(0, 63),
            x_text = c("Extra TCRα", "Extra TCRβ"))

ggsave("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/revisions/figures/3c.pdf", width = 1.0, height = 2.4, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)


### Percentages for the paper
median(paired_df$`Extra TCRα`)
median(paired_df$`Extra TCRβ`)
```

```{r}
############################################################################
###                             Figure 3D                                ###
############################################################################

df3$count[is.na(df3$count)] <- 0

new_df <- df3 %>% filter(specialClone %in% c("Extra TCRα", "Extra TCRβ", "Regular")) %>%
                  group_by(donor) %>% mutate(donorCount2 = sum(count)) %>% ungroup() %>% 
                  mutate(percent = 100 * count / donorCount2)
paired_df <- new_df %>%
                       filter(specialClone %in% c("Extra TCRα", "Extra TCRβ")) %>%
                       select(donor, specialClone, percent) %>%
                       pivot_wider(
                                    names_from = specialClone,
                                    values_from = percent)                    

colnames(paired_df)[2] <- "Alpha"
colnames(paired_df)[3] <- "Beta"

paired_df <- paired_df %>% arrange(Alpha) %>% mutate(alpha_rank = row_number()) %>%
                           arrange(Beta) %>% mutate(beta_rank = row_number())

cor <- cor.test(paired_df$Alpha, paired_df$Beta, method = "spearman")
lb <- paste0("Spearman's ρ = ", round(cor$estimate, 2), ",\np = ", round(cor$p.value, 3))

### 500x500
paired_df %>% ggplot(aes(x = Alpha, y = Beta)) + 
              geom_point(aes(fill = "1"), color = "black", size = 1, stroke = 0.3, shape = 21) + 
              geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "aquamarine4", se = FALSE, lwd = 0.3) + 
              theme_bw() + 
              labs(x = "% of cells with extra TCRα", y = "% of cells with extra TCRβ") +
              annotate(x = 40, y = 9, size = 1.7, "text", label = lb, color = "black") + 
              theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"), 
                    axis.title = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
                    panel.grid = element_blank(),
                    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.7),
                    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
                    legend.position = "none",
                    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.05, "cm")) +
              ylim(0, 9.5) +
              scale_fill_manual(values = alpha("aquamarine4", 0.8))

ggsave("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/revisions/figures/3d.pdf", width = 2, height = 2.1, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r}
############################################################################
###                             Figure 3H                                ###
############################################################################

cd8 <- subset(braun, subset = ClusterName_TCells %in% c("Treg", "Activated CD4.1", "Activated CD4.2", "CD4 TCM.1", "CD4 TCM.2", "Mito-high T cells", "-1"), invert = TRUE)

cd8@meta.data <- cd8@meta.data %>% left_join(matching[, 2:3], by = "Sample")
cd8@meta.data <- as.data.frame(cd8@meta.data)
rownames(cd8@meta.data) <- cd8$Cell_barcode
cd8$Cell_Barcode <- str_replace(cd8$Cell_barcode, "\\-.*$", "-1")

cd8 <- subset(cd8, subset = Cell_barcode %in% cd8s$Cell_barcode)

#ElbowPlot(cd8, ndims = 50)
#cd8 <- RunUMAP(cd8, dims = 1:30)

cd8$ClusterName_TCells[cd8$ClusterName_TCells == "PMCH+ terminally Exhausted CD8.1"] <- "PMCH+ terminally \n Exhausted CD8.1"
cd8$ClusterName_TCells[cd8$ClusterName_TCells == "Terminally exhausted CD8.2"] <- "Terminally \n exhausted CD8.2"
cd8$ClusterName_TCells[cd8$ClusterName_TCells == "Terminally exhausted CD8.3"] <- "Terminally \n exhausted CD8.3"

screp <- scRep(cd8, folders = dirs, batch = "index", group = "tissue", original_barcode = "Cell_Barcode", mode = "standard")
noNaFilterMulti <- scRep(cd8, folders = dirs, batch = "index", group = "tissue", original_barcode = "Cell_Barcode", mode = "noNaFilterMulti")
noNaNoMulti <- scRep(cd8, folders = dirs, batch = "index", group = "tissue", original_barcode = "Cell_Barcode", mode = "noNaNoMulti")

tcre <- cd8s@meta.data %>% select(Cell_barcode, donor, CTaa, cloneCallSource) %>% mutate(type = "tcrEclipse")
scr <- screp@meta.data %>% select(Cell_barcode, donor, CTaa) %>% mutate(cloneCallSource = "scRepertoire") %>% mutate(type = "scRepertoire")
scr2 <- noNaFilterMulti@meta.data %>% select(Cell_barcode, donor, CTaa) %>% mutate(cloneCallSource = "scRepertoire") %>% mutate(type = "noNaFilterMulti")
scr3 <- noNaNoMulti@meta.data %>% select(Cell_barcode, donor, CTaa) %>% mutate(cloneCallSource = "scRepertoire") %>% mutate(type = "noNaNoMulti")

combo <- rbind(tcre, scr, scr2, scr3)
 
tcre_div <- clonalDiversity(cd8s, group.by = "donor", cloneCall = "aa", exportTable = TRUE) %>% mutate(class = "tcrEclipse")
scr_div <- clonalDiversity(screp, group.by = "donor", cloneCall = "aa", exportTable = TRUE) %>% mutate(class = "scRepertoire")
scr2_div <- clonalDiversity(noNaFilterMulti, group.by = "donor", cloneCall = "aa", exportTable = TRUE) %>% mutate(class = "noNaFilterMulti")
scr3_div <- clonalDiversity(noNaNoMulti, group.by = "donor", cloneCall = "aa", exportTable = TRUE) %>% mutate(class = "noNaNoMulti")

div <- rbind(tcre_div, scr_div, scr2_div, scr3_div)

div$class <- factor(div$class, levels = c("tcrEclipse", "scRepertoire", "noNaFilterMulti", "noNaNoMulti"))

div2 <- div %>% ungroup() %>% 
                    select(shannon, class, donor)  %>%
                    pivot_wider(
                                names_from = class,
                                values_from = shannon)

results <- runPairedTests(div2, groups = c("tcrEclipse", "noNaNoMulti", "noNaFilterMulti", "scRepertoire"), adjustment_method = "fdr", runPaired = TRUE)
results$y.position <- c(4.6, 4.8, 5, 5, 5.2, 5.4)

div %>% ggplot(aes(x = class, y = shannon)) + geom_boxplot(aes(fill = class), outlier.size = -1, lwd = 0.9, color = "black", width = 0.4) +
                                              geom_path(aes(group = donor), alpha = 0.3) +
                                              geom_point(color = "grey40", fill = "white", shape = 21, stroke = 1, size = 2) + 
                                              theme_classic() + xlab("") + ylab("Shannon Index") +
                                              stat_pvalue_manual(results, tip.length = 0, side = 4, label = "p.adj2") +
                                              theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"), axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                                                    axis.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
                                                    legend.position = "none") +
                                              scale_fill_manual(values = c("paleturquoise3", "darkorange2", "darkolivegreen3", "hotpink2"))

makeBoxplot(div, 
            x = "class", 
            y = "shannon", 
            group = "donor", 
            x_title = "", 
            y_title = "Shannon index", 
            pval = results, 
            colors = c("paleturquoise3", "darkorange2", "darkolivegreen3", "hotpink2"),
            ylim = c(2, 5.5),
            x_text = c("ECLIPSE", "Lenient standard", "Typical standard", "Strict standard"))

ggsave("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/revisions/figures/3h.pdf", width = 1.7, height = 2.6, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r}
############################################################################
```
```{r}
###                             Figure 3G                                ###
############################################################################
combo2 <- combo %>% group_by(donor, type) %>% mutate(totalCount = n()) %>% ungroup() %>%
                    group_by(donor, type, CTaa) %>% summarise(count = n(),
                                                              pct = 100 * n() / dplyr::first(totalCount),
                                                              total = dplyr::first(totalCount))

combo2 <- combo2 %>% filter(!is.na(CTaa)) %>% arrange(desc(count)) %>% group_by(donor, type) %>% filter(row_number() <= 30) %>% ungroup()

combo3 <- combo2 %>% group_by(donor, type) %>% summarise(mn = mean(count)) %>% ungroup()

combo3$type <- factor(combo3$type, levels = c("tcrEclipse", "scRepertoire", "noNaFilterMulti", "noNaNoMulti"))
combo3 <- combo3 %>% group_by(donor) %>% mutate(pct = (100 * mn / mn[which(type == "noNaNoMulti")]) - 100)
combo3 <- combo3 %>% arrange(type)

combo4 <- combo3 %>% ungroup() %>% 
                    select(type, pct, donor)  %>%
                    pivot_wider(
                                names_from = type,
                                values_from = pct)

results <- runPairedTests(combo4, groups = c("tcrEclipse", "noNaNoMulti", "noNaFilterMulti", "scRepertoire"), adjustment_method = "fdr", runPaired = TRUE)
results$y.position <- c(92, 100, 108, 108, 116, 124)

makeBoxplot(combo3, 
            x = "type", 
            y = "pct", 
            group = "donor", 
            x_title = "", 
            y_title = "% change in mean size of\n top 30 clones", 
            pval = results, 
            colors = c("paleturquoise3", "darkorange2", "darkolivegreen3", "hotpink2"),
            ylim = c(-0.1, 125),
            x_text = c("ECLIPSE", "Lenient standard", "Typical standard", "Strict standard"))

ggsave("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/revisions/figures/3g.pdf", width = 1.7, height = 2.6, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r}
combo <- combo %>% mutate(missing = case_when(
                                               is.na(CTaa) ~ "No TCR\nDetected",
                                              !is.na(CTaa) ~ "Not Missing"))
combo4 <- combo %>% group_by(donor, type) %>% mutate(totalCount = n()) %>% ungroup() %>%
```

```{r}
############################################################################
###                         Extended Data 2C                             ###
############################################################################
set.seed(16)
cd8 <- subset(braun, subset = ClusterName_TCells %in% c("Treg", "Activated CD4.1", "Activated CD4.2", "CD4 TCM.1", "CD4 TCM.2", "Mito-high T cells", "-1"), invert = TRUE)

cd8@meta.data <- cd8@meta.data %>% left_join(matching[, 2:3], by = "Sample")
cd8@meta.data <- as.data.frame(cd8@meta.data)
rownames(cd8@meta.data) <- cd8$Cell_barcode
cd8$Cell_Barcode <- str_replace(cd8$Cell_barcode, "\\-.*$", "-1")

cd8 <- subset(cd8, subset = Cell_barcode %in% cd8s$Cell_barcode)

#ElbowPlot(cd8, ndims = 50)
#cd8 <- RunUMAP(cd8, dims = 1:30)

cd8$ClusterName_TCells[cd8$ClusterName_TCells == "PMCH+ terminally Exhausted CD8.1"] <- "PMCH+ terminally \n Exhausted CD8.1"
cd8$ClusterName_TCells[cd8$ClusterName_TCells == "Terminally exhausted CD8.2"] <- "Terminally \n exhausted CD8.2"
cd8$ClusterName_TCells[cd8$ClusterName_TCells == "Terminally exhausted CD8.3"] <- "Terminally \n exhausted CD8.3"

screp <- scRep(cd8, folders = dirs, batch = "index", group = "tissue", original_barcode = "Cell_Barcode", mode = "standard", cc = "strict")
noNaFilterMulti <- scRep(cd8, folders = dirs, batch = "index", group = "tissue", original_barcode = "Cell_Barcode", mode = "noNaFilterMulti", cc = "strict")
noNaNoMulti <- scRep(cd8, folders = dirs, batch = "index", group = "tissue", original_barcode = "Cell_Barcode", mode = "noNaNoMulti", cc = "strict")

tcre <- cd8s@meta.data %>% select(Cell_barcode, donor, CTaa, cloneCallSource) %>% mutate(type = "tcrEclipse")
scr <- screp@meta.data %>% select(Cell_barcode, donor, CTstrict) %>% mutate(cloneCallSource = "scRepertoire") %>% mutate(type = "scRepertoire")
scr2 <- noNaFilterMulti@meta.data %>% select(Cell_barcode, donor, CTstrict) %>% mutate(cloneCallSource = "scRepertoire") %>% mutate(type = "noNaFilterMulti")
scr3 <- noNaNoMulti@meta.data %>% select(Cell_barcode, donor, CTstrict) %>% mutate(cloneCallSource = "scRepertoire") %>% mutate(type = "noNaNoMulti")

tcre <- tcre %>% dplyr::rename("CTstrict" = CTaa)
combo <- rbind(tcre, scr, scr2, scr3)

tcre_div <- clonalDiversity(cd8s, group.by = "donor", cloneCall = "aa", exportTable = TRUE) %>% mutate(class = "tcrEclipse")
scr_div <- clonalDiversity(screp, group.by = "donor", cloneCall = "strict", exportTable = TRUE) %>% mutate(class = "scRepertoire")
scr2_div <- clonalDiversity(noNaFilterMulti, group.by = "donor", cloneCall = "strict", exportTable = TRUE) %>% mutate(class = "noNaFilterMulti")
scr3_div <- clonalDiversity(noNaNoMulti, group.by = "donor", cloneCall = "strict", exportTable = TRUE) %>% mutate(class = "noNaNoMulti")

div <- rbind(tcre_div, scr_div, scr2_div, scr3_div)

div$class <- factor(div$class, levels = c("tcrEclipse", "scRepertoire", "noNaFilterMulti", "noNaNoMulti"))

div2 <- div %>% ungroup() %>% 
                    select(shannon, class, donor)  %>%
                    pivot_wider(
                                names_from = class,
                                values_from = shannon)

results <- runPairedTests(div2, groups = c("tcrEclipse", "noNaNoMulti", "noNaFilterMulti", "scRepertoire"), adjustment_method = "fdr", runPaired = TRUE)
results$y.position <- c(4.6, 4.8, 5, 5, 5.2, 5.4)

### Diversity
div %>% ggplot(aes(x = class, y = shannon)) + geom_boxplot(aes(fill = class), outlier.size = -1, lwd = 0.9, color = "black", width = 0.4) +
                                              geom_path(aes(group = donor), alpha = 0.3) +
                                              geom_point(color = "grey40", fill = "white", shape = 21, stroke = 1, size = 2) + 
                                              theme_classic() + xlab("") + ylab("Shannon Index") +
                                              stat_pvalue_manual(results, tip.length = 0, side = 4, label = "p.adj2") +
                                              theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"), axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                                                    axis.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
                                                    legend.position = "none") +
                                              scale_fill_manual(values = c("paleturquoise3", "darkorange2", "darkolivegreen3", "hotpink2"))

makeBoxplot(div, 
            x = "class", 
            y = "shannon", 
            group = "donor", 
            x_title = "", 
            y_title = "Shannon index", 
            title = "Gene segment + CDR3\nnt clone calling",
            pval = results, 
            colors = c("paleturquoise3", "darkorange2", "darkolivegreen3", "hotpink2"),
            ylim = c(2, 5.5),
            x_text = c("ECLIPSE", "Lenient standard", "Typical standard", "Strict standard"))

ggsave("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/revisions/figures/s2c.pdf", width = 1.7, height = 2.8, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r}
############################################################################
###                         Extended Data 2F                             ###
############################################################################
noem <- ECLIPSE_noEM(cd8,
                contig_folder_paths = dirs,
                contig_type = "all",
                original_barcode = "Cell_Barcode",
                batch = "index",
                donor = "donor",
                group = "donor")

noem <- subset(noem, subset = Cell_barcode %in% cd8s$Cell_barcode)

no3chain <- ECLIPSE(cd8,
                    contig_folder_paths = dirs,
                    contig_type = "all",
                    original_barcode = "Cell_Barcode",
                    batch = "index",
                    donor = "donor",
                    group = "donor",
                    allowDoubleChains = "Neither")

no3chain <- subset(no3chain, subset = Cell_barcode %in% cd8s$Cell_barcode)

# Downstream analysis p1
cd8s_chains <- cd8s@meta.data %>% select(Cell_barcode, donor, CTaa) %>% mutate(type = "tcrEclipse")
noem_chains <- noem@meta.data %>% select(Cell_barcode, donor, CTaa)  %>% mutate(type = "No_EM")
no3chain_chains <- no3chain@meta.data %>% select(Cell_barcode, donor, CTaa) %>% mutate(type = "No_multi-chain")

combo <- rbind(cd8s_chains, noem_chains, no3chain_chains)

cd8s_div <- clonalDiversity(cd8s, group.by = "donor", cloneCall = "aa", exportTable = TRUE) %>% mutate(class = "tcrEclipse")
noem_div <- clonalDiversity(noem, group.by = "donor", cloneCall = "aa", exportTable = TRUE) %>% mutate(class = "No_EM")
no3chain_div <- clonalDiversity(no3chain, group.by = "donor", cloneCall = "aa", exportTable = TRUE) %>% mutate(class = "No_multi-chain")

div <- rbind(cd8s_div, no3chain_div, noem_div)

div$class <- factor(div$class, levels = c("tcrEclipse", "No_multi-chain", "No_EM"))

div2 <- div %>% ungroup() %>% 
                    select(shannon, class, donor)  %>%
                    pivot_wider(
                                names_from = class,
                                values_from = shannon)

results <- runPairedTests(div2, groups = c("tcrEclipse", "No_multi-chain", "No_EM"), adjustment_method = "fdr", runPaired = TRUE)

            pval = results, 
            colors = c("aquamarine4", "tan", "plum3"),
```
